what: Generative 90s eurodance, pickled in 1995. Press PLAY and Sill writes a song and plays it: offbeat basses, piano and supersaw stabs, a chorus hook with a choir and a key change for the last chorus. Ten styles; steer it with four knobs, break it down, push the key up and play the hook yourself.
author: delirioux
sounds: CC0: Kawai grand from Versilian Studios' VCSL; own drums and choir synthesized by tools/si_drums.py and tools/si_choir.py; drums synthesized by Felucca's tools/gen_waves.py (Hügelton Sample Pack, GPL-3.0-only)
